attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Clock hours (max 10 per calendar day) related to patient care in physical therapy: programs approved by APTA and its components, PTAG or other state chapters, FSBPT (ProCert), CAPTE-accredited PT schools, similar professional organizations; undergoing peer review (15 h) or conducting it (10 h); presenting (max 10 h per topic); poster/platform/article authorship (10 h each, max 20); adjunct teaching (max 20); ABPTS specialist certification (30 h in the biennium awarded); reading literature (max 3); clinical instructor (1 h per 8 h, max 10); advanced internship/mentorship (max 10); charity PT work (1 h per 8 h, max 5); post-professional academic credit (1 credit hour = 10 hours). Orientation, in-services, policy/committee meetings, exhibits and CPR are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies in the first biennium of licensure, but new graduates who passed the NPTE in the current biennium are exempt for that biennium; persons licensed in the last 6 months of a biennium are exempt for that biennium.
rules.audit_note: Licensees must record CE in CE Broker (no cost to licensee); the Board may audit the CE Broker record. Keep original documents at least 5 years.

topics.who: Georgia Ethics and Jurisprudence (contact hours) from a Georgia university with an accredited PT program or a PTAG-approved provider, or passing the Georgia Ethics and Jurisprudence Examination; counts toward the 30 hours

rules.notes: Same rule for PTs and PTAs. Renewal and CE due by December 31 of odd-numbered years. The Board's own pages on sos.ga.gov returned 403 at check time; numbers taken from the Board rule on rules.sos.ga.gov.
